summary: Brand Engagement Network Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement with Ben Capital Fund I, LLC for 25,492 shares at $39.25 per share, representing a 120% premium to the prior closing price, for total gross proceeds of $1,000,561. The investment is structured in two tranches: $250,101 closed on April 21, 2026, and the remaining $750,460 expected to close by May 29, 2026. The SPA includes 100% warrant coverage. The company also received $1,114,164 from warrant exercises. This capital-raising event, while a material agreement, is classified under Capital Returns due to the structured equity issuance at a premium with warrant coverage, reflecting a capital return to the company via equity-linked financing. The regulatory clock is minimal; watch for timely closing of the second tranche.
